summary: Reviewed all 99 files in the work unit. The concept files (lax/pqe/concepts/Lax794877/) contain formal definitions of probabilistic databases, possible worlds, weighted worlds, queries, and axioms stating complexity results (#P-completeness, FP membership, probability ratios). The proof files (lax/pqe/proofs/Lax794877Proofs/DescriptiveComplexity/) contain the actual Lean proofs formalizing descriptive complexity theory: counting classes (#P, FP), witness counting, parsimonious/ordered/relativized reductions, second-order logic, encodings/decodings with polynomial size bounds, fixed point logics, and hardness/completeness for SAT variants, clique counting, and probabilistic query evaluation. The two aggregator files (Lax794877.lean, Lax794877Proofs.lean) are pure import modules but per FILTER-007 serve as navigation metadata and should not be hard-excluded without verified auxiliary search paths. All files contain formal mathematical declarations, definitions, axioms, theorems, or proofs relevant to the corpus. No files meet the high evidence bar for hard exclusion per FILTER-002 and FILTER-004.
